scope: Prevent stale predeclared canonical LTYPE metadata from silently replacing edited callback metadata.
finding: The prior callback check compared application-data and XDATA container sizes only. A changed application-data value with the same group/item counts was accepted while the previously emitted metadata remained unchanged.
change: Compare application-data and XDATA typed values, reactor count, extension-dictionary flag, and pending APPID/LAYER reference fields against the predeclared snapshot. Preserve the existing LIGHTLIST snapshot behavior through the shared comparator.
checks: AC1014 and AC1032 ASCII/Binary controls confirm application-data and XDATA readback.

Same-length text edits, added pending APPID/LAYER references and changed common-object state refuse without changing the existing destination; restoring the original row permits a byte-identical same-writer retry.
Focused CTests for LTYPE allocation, APPID allocation, source-table identities and LIGHTLIST resolver snapshots passed 4/4; the final equal-length mutation control also passed.
Relinked LibreCAD system-codec LTYPE tests passed 17 cases and 4135 assertions with one ODA-fixture case skipped; PR #3269 tests passed 5 cases and 49 assertions.
limitations: The LibreCAD check reused compiled consumer objects rather than a clean consumer rebuild.
The comparator covers the modeled emitted variant values and pending-reference fields; it is not independent proof of producer semantics or complete source graph closure.
